senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正文通常写作 Scofield。输入未提供人物或作品语境，不能直接认定为某一影视角色。IPA 为常见英语读法参考。音节与爪夷文保留数据包中的 null；未确认 DBP 收录，因此不标记为 official。以下为自然的姓名使用组合，不代表经语料统计的高频搭配。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Encik Scofield dah sampai kat lobi. Awak nak turun sekarang?
messages.ms_standard: Encik Scofield sudah tiba di lobi. Adakah awak hendak turun sekarang?
messages.zh: 斯科菲尔德先生到大厅了，你现在要下去吗？
messages.en: Mr Scofield is in the lobby. Are you heading down now?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, saya turun sekarang. Minta dia tunggu sekejap, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya akan turun sekarang. Minta beliau menunggu sebentar.
messages.zh: 嗯，我现在下去。请他稍等一下。
messages.en: Yes, I'm coming down now. Please ask him to wait a moment.

etymology.historical_story: Scofield is recorded as a variant of Schofield, an English surname associated with a place called Scholefield. The related place-name combines historical words for a hut or shed and open land. This geographical history explains the surname; it does not give Scofield a Malay lexical meaning. Sources: [Scofield](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/scofield), [Schofield](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/schofield).
